_comment: TWO release blockers in one run, both in the Brothers' parlor. (1) ADDRESS: Wilovan and his colleagues called every PC 'sir' in 27 shipped lines. `{addr}`/`{Addr}` now resolve at WIGame's own event sink (WIAddress), so this fixture -- the corpus's only pc_gender 'f' save -- pins the SHIPPED talk_pool line and the SHIPPED hub node rendering 'miss', with the 'sir' spelling asserted absent for the whole run. (2) RE-INTERACT: a spent talk_pool on an NPC with no conversation/dialogue fallback used to read `dialogue[0]` off a missing key and throw. Every pool-only NPC in the parlor (ratici + the three gentlemen) is interacted TWICE, and klbkch -- the street's own case -- is teleported to and double-interacted as well; the second interact must re-serve the same line instead of erroring. ci_sweep's SCRIPT ERROR grep is the crash half of that proof, the pinned repeat lines are the behaviour half. No combat, no sleep: the inherited rng_state is inert.
